s: Wuischke (a village in Hochkirch, Bautzen district, Saxony, Germany)
Wuischke (a quarter in Weißenberg, Bautzen district, Saxony, Germany)
Wuischke.et: First mentioned as Ugest parcva in 1419, later as Wugist (1441), Vgest/Vgist (1472), Vgischgk (1499), Wgest (1505). The present-day form appeared at around 1760.
